title: Chapter 611
paragraphs: Chapter 611
Episode 157. The Union of Two Gods
Ring ring.
Ban gave that name to the chaos that had joined him, and before he knew it, a month had passed.
Thanks to becoming a companion creature of the Two Gods, Ring Ring naturally came to hold a sort of mascot status among the Demon King's tribe.
"Ring Ring, it's quite a cute name, isn't it?"
As Jin bit into his cocktail and spoke, Ring Ring, who was sitting on Ban's shoulder, immediately bared his fangs.
[So, you have a problem with it, huh?]
As always, Jin and Ring Ring often squabbled. It's not that they harbored grudges against each other.
"A problem? I just thought it was surprising that the Two Gods brothers would choose such a cute name."
[Humph! So, you're surprised that Ban chose me, you're not happy, is that what you mean?]
"You're interpreting it strangely again. I just found it surprising that the Two Gods brothers would prefer such a cute name..."
[I don't like you.]
"Oh, is that so? I don't particularly like you either."
[Are you challenging me!?]
"Both of you, stop it."
[Meow!]
Listening Ban and Shuri shook their heads. They had been seeing this kind of verbal fight between Jin and Ring Ring whenever they met for a month now.
"I'm sorry, Two Gods brothers."
[I got it, Ban.]
"And Ring Ring, what Jin said is correct. Why do you always misinterpret what Jin says?"
[Why is Ban always on his side?]
"It's because you're the one who's in the wrong."
[Hmm... If Ban insists, I suppose I should apologize?]
Jin shrugged his shoulders, and Ring Ring stuck to Ban's cheek, showing a sullen expression.
"Jin, you're not completely innocent either. Ring Ring just started living in the group, so there are many things he's not familiar with. Even if he makes some mistakes, you should understand."
Ring Ring stuck out his tongue and pulled down his lower eyelid, taunting Jin, who swallowed a laugh and stayed silent.
Every time Ring Ring did this, he got a smack from Ban.
Smack!
[Yikes!]
Ring Ring briefly clenched his forehead, then rubbed his body against Ban's cheek again.
'I can't deal with the Two Gods brothers. I can't believe that guy was that terrible chaos... I just can't adapt.'
He thought it was very nice to see Ban and Ring Ring getting along.
"Now that we've had enough rest, let's start training again."
Ban and Jin faced each other and sat down.
After deciding to accept Ring Ring, they have been practicing 'The Union of Two Gods' every day.
Naturally, the Union of Two Gods was finding stability at a faster pace than before.

Now, the two were able to control the 'synchronization'. The incidents where Jin would lose consciousness from an unintended Union of Two Gods, or where Ban would get tired, had completely disappeared.
It was thanks to Ring Ring voluntarily becoming the link between the two.
Woo woo woo-!
As the two men's cores emitted light, Ban's energy began to gather towards Jin.
Adding Ban's power to the already achieved 10-star energy did not have a dramatically 'visible' effect.
According to Ban's explanation, it was because Jin was still not able to handle even his own power properly.
Though the magnitude of his power had reached 10 stars, he did not have the control typical of a first-class superhuman, so he could not achieve that level of efficiency.
"Jin, you need to accurately understand the magnitude of the power you can handle. Concentrate."
"Yes, Two Gods brother."
Ban's method had many similarities to the heart-eye training Luna had conducted in the past.
Just like when he had awakened his heart-eye, he was 'recognizing' his energy with his eyes closed.
It was like swimming in the ocean. He was forming the ocean of power as an inner image and identifying its size.
How far he could go, where the end was.
As always, Jin was completing the process faster than Ban expected.
Eventually, as Jin narrowed his eyebrows, Ban gave a satisfied smile.
"Did you find it?"

"Yes. As the Two Gods brother said, I can clearly feel when I reach the end. This is the end. And beyond... I see an ocean that seems to be formed by the Two Gods brother's power. Between them is a dark energy."
The dark energy was Ring Ring's. That energy served as both a passage connecting Jin and Ban's powers and a kind of safety device.
It was Ring Ring's will that prevented the two men's powers from mixing too much.
If that wasn't there, there would have been problems with Jin and Ban as had happened when the Union of Two Gods had been manifested before.
"Now that you've reached here, controlling the Union of Two Gods is virtually complete."
"......Even if I resonate with the Two Gods brother right now, my vessel is inadequate and I can't generate a power stronger than the total amount of my energy."
When he had his power taken away by Ring Ring, he felt his whole body filled with Ban's energy.
Then, Jin's vessel was empty, but not now. There was no room for Ban's power to interfere.
However, the Union of Two Gods was a transcendent martial art for two reasons.
"Now that you're with me, you'll never get tired."
When the Union of Two Gods is deployed, Ban's power is added whenever Jin's energy is depleted.
This means that Jin can always maintain the maximum amount of energy.
If the 'Mirror' at the Sword Emperor's Holy War granted Jin divine magic, then Ban gives him infinite aura and energy.
But the real surprise was something else.
"Yes, and the experience, senses, and even the eyes of the Two Gods brother are added..."
Jin, who had been speaking up to that point, suddenly shuddered.
It was because he felt a chill that made his spine tingle.
Just now, Jin accurately perceived the maximum power he possessed, recognized Ring's connection point and the energy of Ban beyond it.
Thanks to the achievement made in a month, the Union of Two Gods showed a different level of resonance than before.
The result is the sharing of experience, senses, and perspective that Ban possesses.
Everything she accumulated as a Two Gods was seeping into Jin's mind.
The memory transfer using Boras' Chief Artisan skill, Valeria's record magic, and the indirect experience through Soldierlet's recording device.
If those are considered a transmission, what Jin is experiencing now is literally a 'union'.
In other words, Jin was no different from becoming Ban.
'It feels like a blind person opening his eyes...'
Even the familiar scenery of the training ground looked completely different.
Which wall was weak, which ground was firm, how diverse the wind was flowing, Jin was able to recognize all of that.
A sensation like observing the world as a god, not a human. Jin was shivering at the feeling.
Even the breathing of the other brothers far away, outside the training ground, was clearly conveyed.
'Does the Two Gods brother live with this sensation normally?'
As Jin now, he couldn't maintain that state for long. Just standing still, difficult to handle information and senses were being conveyed, and just processing that was enough to make him breathless.
When the Union of Two Gods was first deployed, Jin felt like he had been reborn. Compared to now, that was nothing.
The light that was coloring the two's cores weakened. Ban had dissolved the Union of Two Gods before Jin got more tired.
"Huh."
Jin could only make a startled expression like someone who had witnessed a miracle that no one would believe.
Also, he barely managed to suppress a great feeling of regret.
As soon as the Union of Two Gods was undone, it felt like the world had returned to monochrome.

No longer did the ground and wind of the training ground convey themselves precisely and perfectly, and the breath of the brothers was no longer felt. The sensation of becoming a god disappeared as if it had been a dream.
"You look quite shocked, Brother Jin."
"It's not just that. Just now, I felt like I reached the pinnacle of creation without any effort..."
"That's not true. From the beginning, it's because of the achievement you've made yourself that my senses were transferred to that extent."
Just as Jin felt Ban's senses, Ban also fully felt Jin's feelings.
"......That much? You mean, that wasn't all?"
To that, Ban responded with a soft smile.
"Brother Jin, I am a Two Gods."
[Yeah, our Ban is a Two Gods! Know that this is an honor, you poor thing!]
[Meow, meow?]
In response to Ringring, Shuri made a sound as if to ask why he was so proud, but Jin couldn't recover from the shock for a while. At the fact that the 'Ban' he had just experienced was not all.
'How strong are the Two Gods brothers, really......?'
In the past, on the day he was able to spar with Ban for the first time.
Even then, Jin felt that Ban was a distant, massive wall, and it had always been that way since.
But now, stronger than ever before, she seemed furthest away.
"You too will be able to enter the same realm as me. If not, you wouldn't have been able to receive my senses at all."
Ban doesn't lie. Jin nodded silently. He didn't know when, but if she said so, it meant he could definitely reach it.
"The sensation may have disappeared, but the memory should remain, Brother Jin."
"Yes, Brother Two Gods."
Even though it felt like the world had turned back to monochrome, he clearly remembered the sensations he experienced while the Union of Two Gods was in progress.
"I will proceed with training through that sensation. In other words, you will learn to fight like me. Also, we will work on increasing the duration of the Union of Two Gods."
There was no training in the world that could make him grow faster. Jin was convinced of that.
[If you want to increase the duration, it would be good to show me some respect?]
"Hey, Ringring."
[Hehe.]
"Once Brother Jin's achievements reach a certain level, we will start sparring with the Two Kings brothers again. The first opponent is, the Twelfth Two Kings brother."
Twelfth Two Kings, Teto. The reason why Ban chose Teto as the first opponent is because he is the weakest among the Two Kings.
Ban was looking forward to seeing Jin defeat the Two Kings one by one in order of their combat power.
"I understand."
